description: Defines test classes for QUIC client testing, including MockableQuicClient and QuicTestClient, with methods for sending requests, managing streams, and configuring client behavior.

classes.name: MockableQuicClient
classes.description: A mockable QUIC client class for testing, allowing control over connection IDs, packets, and network helper.

classes.name: QuicTestClient
classes.description: A test utility client for sending requests, managing streams, and testing QUIC server interactions.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a simple GET request to the server.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Wraps data in a QUIC packet and sends it.

methods.name: SetUserAgentID
methods.description: Sets the user agent ID for the client.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the server.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the client from the server.
